settings.heading: Your miles, made permanent.
settings.text: Every run you've recorded is already a drawing. Etch composes it — the route, the city, the numbers that mattered — into a piece worth framing, printed on museum-grade paper and made to order.

settings.title: Run it
settings.copy: A marathon, a first 5K, the loop you've done a hundred times. If it's in your running app, it can become a piece.

settings.title: Compose it
settings.copy: Open it in Etch Studio and choose a finished look — city streets in pale grey, terrain contours in gold on ink, the classic atlas. Refine the type, the data, the colour.

settings.title: Hang it
settings.copy: Printed giclée on archival paper, framed in solid hardwood if you like, and shipped ready to hang. Made to order, one at a time.

settings.name: Streets
settings.line: Just the streets, in pale grey — the route inked over.

settings.name: Streets Noir
settings.line: Faint streets on near-black, the route in white.

settings.name: Midnight Atlas
settings.line: Gold contour lines across deep ink, the route aglow.

settings.heading: Choose a finished look, not a template.
settings.text: Each edition is an authored composition — palette, type, and map treatment resolved together. Your route is the only variable.

settings.label: Paper
settings.text: 200gsm archival fine-art stock, giclée printed at 300 DPI.

settings.label: Frame
settings.text: Solid hardwood in black or natural, with shatterproof glazing. Full bleed — no mat, no border.

settings.label: Production
settings.text: Made to order, one at a time, and shipped ready to hang. Nothing is warehoused.

settings.label: Sizes
settings.text: 12 × 18″, 16 × 24″ and 24 × 36″ — one proportion, chosen so the composition is never cropped.

settings.heading: Do I need the Etch app?
settings.row_content: Yes — the artwork is composed from your own activity in Etch Studio, inside the free iOS app. You design the piece there; the store handles the printing, framing and shipping.

settings.heading: How long until it arrives?
settings.row_content: Each piece is printed to order. Unframed prints typically produce in 2–3 business days, framed pieces in 3–5, plus standard shipping.

settings.heading: Which running apps work?
settings.row_content: Etch syncs with Apple Health and Strava, and imports GPX and TCX files from almost anything else — so races and runs from other apps come along too.

settings.heading: What if it arrives damaged?
settings.row_content: We replace damaged pieces, no questions asked. Get in touch with your order number and a photo and a new one goes into production.

settings.paragraph: New editions, occasional pieces we love, nothing noisy.
